name: Window or door unit (generic)
description: A placeholder window or door unit that fills a framed opening until a specific product is picked. Builders add one to every opening. Listed first on purpose.

name: Single-hung window
description: Vinyl single-hung window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Bottom sash slides up.

name: Double-hung window
description: Vinyl double-hung window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Both sashes slide and tilt in for cleaning.

name: Casement window
description: Vinyl casement window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Hinged at the side, cranks out.

name: Sliding window
description: Vinyl horizontal sliding window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin.

name: Awning window
description: Vinyl awning window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Hinged at the top, opens out.

name: Fixed (picture) window
description: Vinyl fixed picture window, double-pane low-E, nailing fin. Does not open.

name: Entry door (prehung)
description: Prehung fiberglass exterior door, 36 x 80in, in its frame. Glass panels in doors must be safety glazing.

name: French patio door (prehung)
description: Prehung double French patio door, about 60 x 80in, tempered glass.

name: Sliding glass door
description: Vinyl sliding patio door, 72 x 80in, tempered double-pane low-E glass.

name: Tempered safety glass
description: Tempered glass panel: required near pools, in doors and next to them, and in other hazardous locations.
